keyEvents.text: Goal! Chesterfield 0, Yeovil Town 1. Slavi Spasov (Yeovil Town) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Goal! Chesterfield 1, Yeovil Town 1. Jack Simpson (Chesterfield) header from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Josh Koroma.
Goal! Chesterfield 2, Yeovil Town 1. Josh Koroma (Chesterfield) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Remeao Hutton.
Goal! Chesterfield 3, Yeovil Town 1. Jack Simpson (Chesterfield) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kiano Dyer.
Goal! Chesterfield 3, Yeovil Town 2. James Daly (Yeovil Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Charlie Lennon.
Goal! Chesterfield 3, Yeovil Town 3. Hayden Muller (Yeovil Town) header from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Stephen Walker following a corner.
Goal! Chesterfield 4, Yeovil Town 3. Joel Randall (Chesterfield) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Dilan Markanday.
